text: がんばりを　みとめて　すてみタックルを　おしえよう！

structure.jp: がんばりを　みとめて

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending says the speaker has decided to do something, like 'I shall' or 'let me'. おしえよう = 'I'll teach you'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one and here gives the reason for it. がんばりを　みとめて = 'recognizing your effort, (I'll...)'.
